verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs claim support for open standards (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON) and its own open file format, and self-hosting gives users control over where their data lives. However, nothing documents a bulk export of all account or team data, and one older hands-on report says only individual layers could be exported, not a whole design as a single file. missing for 10: documented bulk/full-account export workflow, documentation of the open file format's contents and portability, independent confirmation that a complete exit is possible.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Enjoy open standards like CSS, HTML, SVG and JSON as well as Penpot's open file format.
